items.name: FMC Swiss Nationals 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAyOTcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a950a743f01954e5f9a61747f4bd930d0a9fb9aa/FMCSN25.png)
***

[DE]
Das ist die Schweizer-Meisterschaft für 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.
Die Competition findet in Olten (SO) und Sonvico (TI) gleichzeitig statt.

Die Teilnehmer **müssen** in den Anmeldekommentaren den Ort angeben, an dem sie teilnehmen möchten.

[FR]
Il s'agit d'un championnat national de 3x3x3 Fewest Moves en Suisse.
Cette compétition se déroulera simultanément à Olten (SO) et Sonvico (TI).

Les participants **DOIVENT** préciser dans les commentaires d'inscription le lieu où ils souhaitent participer.

[IT]
Questo è un campionato nazionale per 3x3x3 Fewest Moves in Svizzera.
Questa competizione si svolgerà simultaneamente in Olten (SO) e Sonvico (TI).

I partecipanti **DEVONO** specificare nei commenti della registrazione il luogo in cui desiderano di partecipare.

[EN]
This is a national championship for the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves in Switzerland.
This competition takes place simultaneously in Olten (SO) and Sonvico (TI).

Competitors **MUST** specify in the comment of the registration the place they wish to participate.

items.name: OKC Unorthodox Blocks 2025

venue.name: [Oklahoma City Convention Center](https://okcconventioncenter.com/)
venue.address: 100 Mick Cornett Dr, Oklahoma City, OK 73109

items.information:
Please Note: This competition is on a Sunday. 
												This is not a normal competition please refer to the [ Look here for UNOFFICIAL EVENTS!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OKCUnorthodoxBlocks2025#60237-look-here-for-unofficial-events) tab or reach out to the organization team for any questions!

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OKCUnorthodoxBlocks2025#59645-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OKCUnorthodoxBlocks2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue.***   

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
